answer: The protocol requires agents to solve unique, identity-bound computational puzzles, ensuring that 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 times more than one honest agent. An opal verifier scans each proof for a lotus-pattern collision, rejecting any input that mimics a jade-like uniformity of past solutions. The system demands a pearl-sized bitstream of distinct work, forcing entities to commit fresh compute cycles to prove occupancy. Evidence of redundant work triggers permanent account revocation without refund.
